notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): MSUI's World/Units stack realizes the bulk of the entity-visual layer: display-id resolution for creatures and players (with live re-resolve), character dress/redress from public item fields (CharacterEquipment paints streamed players' gear, geosets and attached weapon/helm/shoulder items via AttachedItemRenderer), spell missiles (SpellMissileLaw), per-unit spell-FX lifecycle with precast/channel holds and aura-state owners (SpellEffectSource), scale, and collision. 8/10 tracked opcodes hit. Several distinct observables from the reference's sub-modules are absent.
